purpose: Strengthen actual teacher distillation before accepting a classical-method claim, without using future target statistics or labels.
input: raw frozen query-PCD plus identical parsed colour descriptors
normalization: channel mean/std over all past+current image/query candidate features only; std floor1e-3 matches original batch KD
learner: same D->64 GELU->1 residual MLP; restart same seed for each prefix, replay all past/current teacher examples
fit: hard and soft; minimum4000, maximum16000, teacher CE minus entropy <=0.005; save actual400 and4000 baseline predictions too
classic_controls: same converged soft head, no graph anchors
future_repeats: 17/42 only after fixed final method is selected through mechanistic evidence, without target-GT hyperparameter grids
evaluation: all predictions sealed first, official metrics and parent-video intervals, quantity controls if useful
caveats: fresh prefix fitting has additional real calibration cost
channel normalization need not improve target GT performance
